title: sql2 action
description: Runs an SQL statement with parameters on a database that dil.core.connections defines. :#name is the value of the header name (a header that is not there fails the message) and :#${expression} that of a simple expression; both are sent as parameters, never written in the statement. The body and the headers are as with the sql action.

query.title: Query
query.description: The statement, such as SELECT * FROM Employees WHERE EmployeeID = :#EmployeeID

dataSource.title: Data source
dataSource.description: The id of a connection in dil.core.connections; the DIL parser turns it into the option connection

connection.title: Connection
connection.description: JSON object with dbtype (postgres, mysql, sqlserver or oracle), dbname, host, port, username and password; from dataSource

useSSL.title: Use SSL
useSSL.description: Connect over TLS, checking the certificate of the server against the trust store

tlsVersion.title: TLS version
tlsVersion.description: With useSSL: the one version of TLS to use, TLSv1, TLSv1.1, TLSv1.2 or TLSv1.3; empty means 1.2 or later

trustStoreFile.title: Trust store
trustStoreFile.description: PKCS#12 keystore with the certificates to trust with useSSL; "" trusts the system's roots

trustStorePassword.title: Trust store password
trustStorePassword.description: Trust store password; env DIF_TRUSTSTORE_PASSWORD (or its _FILE companion)

connectTimeout.title: Connect timeout
connectTimeout.description: Milliseconds the connection may take to set up
